notes.title: New Version Lauched
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We have listen to your suggestions and we are glad to announce the following improvements:

 
    Fast forward button, now you can run your experiments twice the speed!
    Better zoom, increased zoom out lets you always see the hole experiment
    Better graphics, 4k graphics and better post processing.

notes.title: New update released to fix issues on level 15.
notes.content:
We  have just released a patch to fix an issue on level 15. The cannon tutorial was not working properlly, making it impossible for the player to progress.

Please grab the latest update, if this is still a problem after the update, or if you encouter any other issues, please let us know and we will fix it ASAP.

Thanks "Singularity Axiom╘[◉_◉]╛" for reporting the issue.
